answers.core: It could also be in another project, eg. godot-cpp-extra, and have those includes there that include then either godot-cpp or godot. But I would rather they are somewhere where they are maintained as first class citizen, eg godot-cpp.
answers.workaround: It can be used by adding these ifdefs to every addon/module project.

title: Add an easier way to support GDExtensions for both addons and modules, specifically for includes
